engineering_scope: Three 8-second synthetic processes on one new binary: observer control, gain-observe, gain-unity. Five pre-DSP 10-ms negative requests; no historical acoustic execution or scientific input.

engineering_method_correction.observed: 3 native synthetic successes plus 5 pre-DSP rejections; paired strict trace failed at block 0. Both 2000-block low/high CNG imaginary vectors differ only at bins 0 and 64; every other observed upstream field and all defined CNG words equal. Existing GenerateComfortNoise writes real endpoints and interior real/imaginary bins only; CopyToPackedArray omits endpoint imaginary words. First failure remains immutable. Correct observer to read only defined generated words; no generated CNG bytes, DSP, support, input signal, comparison of defined words, metric or science budget changed. Prior low-band suppression arithmetic reads unwritten endpoint slots; this research observation does not fix or certify that upstream behavior. No scientific call made.
